# BloxSmith

> AI-powered Roblox game builder. Describe a game in plain English and BloxSmith generates Luau scripts, UI, full game systems, and Toolbox asset insertions — synced directly into Roblox Studio via a companion plugin.

BloxSmith helps Roblox creators ship playable games faster. It runs in the browser, generates production-ready Luau, and pushes changes into Roblox Studio in one click using the BloxSmith Studio plugin.
